      const token = authStorageGet(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);

      const pendingWindow = prepareMobileNavigationWindow();
      const originalOpacity = linkElement ? linkElement.style.opacity : '';
      const originalPointerEvents = linkElement ? linkElement.style.pointerEvents : '';

      if (linkElement) {
        linkElement.style.opacity = '0.65';
        linkElement.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      }

      setMessage('جاري فتح الصفحة...', false);

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          if (linkElement) {
            linkElement.style.opacity = originalOpacity;
            linkElement.style.pointerEvents = originalPointerEvents;
          }

          if (response && response.ok && response.authenticated) {

            let destinationUrl = String(response.url || '').trim();

            const navigationTicket = String(
              response.ticket ||
              response.navigationTicket ||
              ''
            ).trim();

            if (destinationUrl) {

              if (
                navigationTicket &&
                destinationUrl.indexOf('ticket=') === -1
              ) {
                destinationUrl +=
                  (destinationUrl.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') +
                  'ticket=' +
                  encodeURIComponent(navigationTicket);
              }

              if (viewMode === 'executive' || viewMode === 'students') {
                destinationUrl +=
                  (destinationUrl.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') +
                  'view=' +
                  encodeURIComponent(viewMode);
              }

              if (target === 'direct' && requestId) {
                destinationUrl +=
                  (destinationUrl.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') +
                  'requestId=' + encodeURIComponent(String(requestId));
              }

              showNavigationFallback(destinationUrl);
              if (pendingWindow && !pendingWindow.closed) {
                pendingWindow.location.replace(destinationUrl);
                return;
              }

              try {
                window.top.location.href = destinationUrl;
              } catch (navigationError) {
                showNavigationFallback(destinationUrl);
              }
              return;
            }
          }

          if (!response || !response.authenticated) {
            closePendingNavigationWindow(pendingWindow);
            clearSession();
            showLogin(
              response && response.message
                ? response.message
                : 'انتهت الجلسة. سجّل الدخول من جديد.'
            );
            return;
          }

          closePendingNavigationWindow(pendingWindow);
          setMessage(
            response.message || 'تعذر فتح الصفحة.',
            true
          );
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          closePendingNavigationWindow(pendingWindow);
          if (linkElement) {
            linkElement.style.opacity = originalOpacity;
            linkElement.style.pointerEvents = originalPointerEvents;
          }
